text:
Alex: quick ping — opened PR  #3821 with a tiny kvcache rename + some reformatting. CI is red on fmt and proto diffs, wondering if anyone can take a look? link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/p/pl/3821>
Jamie: looking now. saw fmt error on the check run: 'gofumpt -w' changed a generated file, so CI flags it. :eyes:
Alex: yeah, I ran genproto locally which rewrote a bunch of whitespace in pkg/pb/cache.pb.go — I didn't intend to include generated changes in this PR, my bad.
Sana: if it's generated we should exclude it from the commit. can you split the generated file into a separate commit (or revert it) and push a follow-up? I can approve after that.
Alex: will do. quick question — is there an established pattern for generated files so linter/formatters ignore them? I added the standard header but ci still runs gofumpt.
Jamie: header helps linters, but gofumpt/gofmt always formats. we rely on not committing generated files unless they were intentionally changed. two options: 1) revert generated changes and add a note in PR saying 'no proto changes' or 2) keep them and move any hand edits to a separate change with explanation.
Ryan: for small refactors like this I'd prefer we keep generated files out — reduces churn in history. splitting is easiest.
Alex: ok splitting now. also jamie, CI complained about a varname nit in pkg/kvcache/store.go: uses 'resp' for the return struct; linter wants 'result' per our code-style rule. should I rename in this PR or separate? here's the snippet:
```
- func (s *Store) Get(key string) (*resp, error) {
+ func (s *Store) Get(key string) (*result, error) {
    // ...
 }
```
Jamie: tiny rename is fine to include, it's consistent with guidelines. leave a clear commit message 'rename resp -> result to satisfy linters'
Sana: thanks — if you push the split and the rename I'll run the approval. I can also re-run the formatter locally if you want a hand.
Alex: pushed: split out generated file into separate commit 4799999999-generate-split + renamed resp->result. CI-bot: please re-run checks? :pray:
CI-bot: build queued — running fmt + unit tests. (fmt failed on one other file: pkg/api/handlers.go line 128 — trailing comma in composite literal was reformatted.)
Jamie: small one — I can fix that inline with a follow-up commit to avoid holding the whole PR. Alex, do you want me to push? or prefer you to amend?
Alex: please go ahead, thanks. I want to keep this PR small.
Sana: once fmt is green I'll give the approval. :thumbsup:
CI-bot: fmt passed. unit tests failing on TestCacheExpiry — looks unrelated, rerunning.
Ryan: if unit flaky, put a quick note in PR and we can land with a flaky-test waiver if infra team agrees, but prefer to fix before merging.
Alex: re-ran tests, they passed. merging in ~10m pending the final approvals. cheers folks.
Jamie: approved. :white_check_mark:
Sana: approved. :white_check_mark:
Alex: merged — thanks all. (merge commit 4799999999)
